entries.name: Lunar New Year
entries.capsule: Start of the Chinese lunisolar year: family reunions, dumplings and fish, red envelopes, and lion dances across Minnesota.
entries.dateRule: First day of the first month of the Chinese lunisolar calendar, between January 21 and February 20. Minnesota public events spread over the following weeks.

dates.source: GovHK general holidays 2026; Minnesota Monthly (Year of the Horse begins Tuesday, Feb. 17)
Calculated from the Chinese lunisolar calendar (seed); not yet confirmed

entries.whatItMarks: The start of the lunisolar year, a time of renewal, family gatherings and wishes for luck and prosperity. Minnesota guides describe foods chosen for meaning: dumplings for wealth, long noodles for long life, whole fish for abundance.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: In 2026: CAAM Chinese Dance Theater's production at the O'Shaughnessy (Jan. 17-18); the Chinese Community Center's festival at Asia Mall, Eden Prairie (Feb. 15), described as one of the largest in the state; a Chinese Heritage Foundation celebration at Luce Line Brewing, Plymouth (Feb. 21); the Twin Cities Dumpling Feast at Peking Garden, St. Paul (Feb. 25); a Minnesota Orchestra concert with a pre-concert set by Gao Hong and the Carleton Chinese Music Ensemble (Feb. 26); and restaurant specials. Midtown Global Market and Theater Mu postponed or canceled 2026 events because of a surge of ICE agents in Minneapolis. The holiday is also marked by Vietnamese, Korean, Hmong, Taiwanese and other communities.

entries.name: CAAM Chinese Dance Theater Lunar New Year Production
entries.capsule: Annual Lunar New Year dance-drama by the Chinese American Association of Minnesota's Chinese Dance Theater in St. Paul.
entries.dateRule: Announced each year by CAAM; held in January or February before or around Lunar New Year.
entries.whatItMarks: Lunar New Year, through a full-length Chinese dance production; the 2026 show, The Tale of the Peacock, drew on Dai ethnic folklore.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Staged at the O'Shaughnessy at St. Catherine University; Chinese Dance Theater was founded in 1992 and marked its 30th anniversary in 2022-2023.

entries.name: Chinese Community Center Lunar New Year Festival
alsoKnownAs: Lunar New Year at Asia Mall
entries.capsule: Large Lunar New Year street-fair style festival at Asia Mall in Eden Prairie with performances, food and market stalls.
entries.dateRule: Announced each year by the Chinese Community Center; held on a weekend near Lunar New Year.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Cultural performances, food and market stalls and activities, 12 to 5 p.m. on Feb. 15, 2026; a visitor testimonial on the center's site describes a crowded 2025 festival with business booths and food stations.

entries.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
entries.capsule: Harvest full-moon festival on the 15th day of the eighth lunar month: mooncakes, lanterns and family reunion.
entries.dateRule: Fifteenth day of the eighth month of the Chinese lunisolar calendar.

dates.source: Calculated (seed); GovHK lists the day following the Mid-Autumn Festival as Sept. 26, 2026
Calculated (seed); GovHK lists the day following as Sept. 16, 2027

entries.whatItMarks: The harvest moon and family reunion.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The Minnesota China Friendship Garden Society and ASANE have held a Mid-Autumn Moon Festival at the China Friendship Garden in Phalen Regional Park, St. Paul, but announced there would be none in 2026. The Chinese Community Center posted a call for 2026 Mid-Autumn volunteers on Sept. 8, 2026, without event details. The Twin Cities Chinese Language School lists Moon Festival celebrations among its activities.

entries.name: Dragon Boat Festival
entries.capsule: Early-summer festival on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, known for dragon boat races and sticky rice dumplings.
entries.dateRule: Fifth day of the fifth month of the Chinese lunisolar calendar.

dates.source: GovHK general holidays 2026 (Tuen Ng Festival, 19 June)
GovHK general holidays 2027 (Tuen Ng Festival, 9 June)

entries.whatItMarks: A traditional early-summer festival; in China dragon boat races date back more than 2,000 years.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: No Chinese-organized Duanwu observance in Minnesota was found. St. Paul's pan-Asian Dragon Festival at Lake Phalen, founded in 2000, features dragon boat races in July rather than on the lunar date; it returned July 13, 2024, after a four-year pause. No 2025 or 2026 date was confirmed.

entries.name: CAAM Annual Celebration and Scholarship Awards
entries.capsule: Chinese American Association of Minnesota's yearly gala honoring scholarship winners and volunteers.
entries.dateRule: Announced each year by CAAM; held in spring.
entries.whatItMarks: CAAM's history (59 years in 2026), its Stanley & Marvel Chong Scholarships and its festival volunteers.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held in St. Paul on May 9, 2026; 11 Chinese American high school seniors received $2,000 to $5,000 scholarships.
